en.headline: Man in 20s attacked with knives at Tsuen Wan bar, suspects flee
en.dek: Police are investigating after a man in his twenties was stabbed in the head and hand at a bar on Sha Tsui Road in the early hours of Sunday.
body: Police said a man in his twenties was attacked by two to three men with knives at a bar on the ground floor of 121 Sha Tsui Road in Tsuen Wan at about 2:22 a.m. on Sunday.
The victim suffered injuries to his head and hand and was conscious when taken by ambulance to Yan Chai Hospital for treatment. The suspects fled the scene after the attack, according to police.
Officers are investigating the case. Bar staff reported the incident, and other patrons remained at the premises after police attended.

zh.headline: 荃灣酒吧男子遭持刀襲擊 頭手受傷清醒送院
zh.dek: 警方調查周日凌晨約2時22分，一名20多歲男子在沙咀道酒吧遭兩至三名男子持刀襲擊，頭部及手部受傷。
body: 警方表示，周日凌晨約2時22分，一名20多歲男子在荃灣沙咀道121號地下一間酒吧內，遭兩至三名男子持刀襲擊。
傷者頭部及手部受傷，保持清醒，由救護車送往仁濟醫院治理。疑犯逾凶後逃離現場，警方正調查案件。
酒吧職員報案，警員到場後，現場仍有其他酒客逗留。案件由警方跟進。
